_comment: Resolver-coverage FLOOR for scripts/validate-resolver-coverage.mjs. The guard fails the build when measured coverage drops below this. The floor only ever RATCHETS UP as the resolver gets fixed — never down to make a red build go green. Cards: tw-2026-09-12-011 (the resolver fix).
note: Baseline RAISED 2026-09-12 (batch 044). The 0.05 floor and canary_floor 0 were never a test: the resolver had already been fixed by the 2026-09-12 graph-builder patch, so measured coverage was 0.6625 and all 5 canaries resolved, while the committed floor still sat at 0.05 (5%) and canary_floor at 0. A floor set an order of magnitude below reality is a guard that cannot fail — exactly the failure mode card tw-2026-09-12-034 was written about. Floors now sit just under measured so a regression bites: coverage 0.66 (measured 0.6625) and canary 5/5 (measured 5/5). Floors only ever ratchet UP. NOT raised to the theoretical maximum because the remaining gap is genuine — see card tw-2026-09-12-047: 638 of the 679 unresolved references name a real person who has no vault page, or carry a middle name the record's frontmatter never recorded.
